title: MedicalRSI: Medical Recursive Self-Improving Agents via Clinical Model-Harness Co-Evolution
reasons: 医学、生物医学或临床专题，超出当前 Agent 与通用模型评测方向
missingSignals: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
描述评分指标或评测协议
报告基线或多个模型的评测
材料中提供代码或数据链接（未核验内容）
给出任务规模或覆盖范围
讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: However, achieving RSI for medical agents is challenging, because clinical workflows rarely come with a reference harness, and a change that fixes early errors may not fix the problems the agent meets later.
